title: One Take, No Second Chances
tagline: A forty-foot fall scheduled for this afternoon, a director who wants it in one take, and a rigging check that just turned up something odd.

wake_up.text: Call time is 6 AM. Today's the big fall sequence — the one you've been training for over the last three weeks.

choices.text: Do your complete warmup and mobility routine before leaving
A light stretch is enough — save the energy for the stunt

set_arrival.text: The set is already alive with activity — grips, camera crew, the stunt coordinator running through today's sequence one more time.

choices.text: Check in with the stunt coordinator

random_moment.text: The morning setup on a stunt-heavy shoot day has its own particular rhythm — a little different every time.

choices.text: A few crew members stop by with genuine encouragement
A brief weather delay pushes the schedule slightly
The morning light is exactly what the cinematographer wanted

wire_rehearsal.text: A slow, careful walkthrough of the fall sequence without cameras — the rigging, the landing zone, the exact choreography of the stunt.

choices.text: Insist on a full dry run at reduced height first
Trust the walkthrough and save time for the actual shot

rigging_check.text: Final rigging check before lunch. Your rigger pauses on one of the connection points — nothing obviously wrong, but something about the wear pattern doesn't sit right with them.

choices.text: Hear the rigger out

rigging_decision.text: The rigger thinks the connection point is probably fine, but isn't fully certain. Replacing it means a two-hour delay on a schedule that's already tight, with the director watching the clock. This is the exact moment stunt performers are trained never to rush.

choices.text: Replace the gear, full stop, whatever it costs the schedule
Have the rigger reinforce the point rather than fully replace it
Proceed as planned — it's probably nothing
Bring in a second rigger for an independent opinion

rigging_outcome_replace.text: The replacement costs two hours and a testy conversation with the production schedule — and the new gear is unquestionably solid. The fall, when it finally happens, goes exactly to plan.

choices.text: Perform the stunt

rigging_outcome_reinforce.text: The reinforcement holds, and the stunt goes off without incident — a reasonable middle path that respects both the schedule and the actual risk.

choices.text: Perform the stunt

rigging_outcome_proceed.text: The stunt goes ahead on schedule, and the gear holds — this time. It's the kind of call that looks fine in hindsight and terrible in the moment it was actually made.

choices.text: Perform the stunt

rigging_outcome_second.text: The second rigger's independent read confirms the gear is sound after all — a slightly longer process, but everyone on set, including you, goes into the fall with real confidence instead of a shrug.

choices.text: Perform the stunt

afternoon_shoot.text: The fall lands clean. The director wants one more angle covered — a second take of a stunt you're not contractually required to repeat today.

choices.text: Agree to the second take for the better coverage
Decline — one clean take is what was agreed

wardrobe_fitting.text: A wardrobe fitting for tomorrow's fight choreography sequence, plus a run-through of the moves with the stunt coordinator.

choices.text: Do a full rehearsal of tomorrow's sequence today
Do a quick walkthrough and save the rest for tomorrow

end_shift.text: Set wraps for the day. Every muscle in your body knows exactly how much work today actually was.

choices.text: Head back to the hotel

triumphant.title: The Shot They'll Use in the Trailer
triumphant.blurb: Every call today was the right one, including the hardest one. This is the stunt people ask you about for years.

steady_hand.title: Clean and Professional
steady_hand.blurb: No injuries, no drama — just careful, well-executed stunt work, take after take.

ordinary_day.title: Another Day on Set
ordinary_day.blurb: A solid day of stunt work, landed clean. Tomorrow's sequence is already being rigged.

burned_out.title: Running on Empty
burned_out.blurb: You made it through the day, but your body is telling you exactly what that cost. This pace needs real recovery time.

written_up.title: Safety Review Called
written_up.blurb: Something about today's rigging call is heading into a safety review. Nobody was hurt. The production still wants answers.
